concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-gift-cards-stored-value-api-load]] — 2026-09-15-captured Stored Value API /load guide for activated gift-card funding, token/non-token request paths and Success/balance response; source warns load is not a payment refund and examples conflict.
warnings: /load cannot refund an original payment despite example prose calling a merchandiseReturn load a refund.
Response prose labels balances USD 30/EUR 40 while sample currentBalance.value fields are 30000/40000; no shopper balance is verified.
Provider/channel checks and sample currencies do not establish merchant-specific enablement or card activation.
